actual_scope: Construct and verify a rational rank-9 bilinear formula for regular convolution in the nonabelian group algebra Q[S3], then screen replacing 36 rank-one products by one rank-9 child in the selected 112-port local-profile ceiling model. Determine the zero-overhead 5% boundary for k up to 67 using only the selected rank-one count; do not assert any provider occurrence.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card covers rank-shape decoders broadly. This experiment changes the underlying algebra from generic all-pairs or cyclic convolution to nonabelian S3 group-algebra multiplication, using the distinct Wedderburn factor Q x Q x M2(Q) and a Strassen matrix component. Existing cyclic C3, Karatsuba, and direct-sum block claims do not supply this S3 tensor or its selected-profile cost boundary.
bottleneck_link: An S3 convolution tensor replaces 36 pairwise scalar products by nine bilinear products. Eight compatible blocks would cross the conditional selected-profile 5% ceiling screen before implementation charges; the source map and its bill determine whether that local saving can be realized.
stop_rule: Derive the rational transforms and rank-9 terms; verify all 36 group-basis products, dirty-output inversion, deterministic integer fixtures, a semantic negative control, source/profile pins, and the exact k=7/8 plus added-child cost boundary. Stop before supplier claims unless eight disjoint source/target support blocks and their complete linear, copy, frame, hosting, precision, restoration, and interface invoice are established.
evidence: The exact Q[S3] decomposition uses two scalar products and Strassen rank seven for M2(Q), yielding a verified rank-9 formula against 36 pair products. The pinned profile has 2,412 rank-one children per orientation (count-only capacity 67 blocks). Under the zero-implementation-charge relaxation, k=7 fails the 5% ceiling target and k=8 passes; after k=8, one added rank-one-equivalent charge passes and two fail. RESULT.json records all rational transforms, exact moment intervals, linear supports, and denominator-six output map. No S3 support occurrence or selected-provider placement is established.
